question: Can the Theta_1 vertex -g sum_A O_A^2 arise by eliminating a heavy source mode, and does the source contain such a mode?
verdict_scope: Elimination mechanism exact at second order (toy check of the operator identity); dictionary exact on V = 16 x 2 under Spin(10) x SU(2) x Z4; inventory at the level of the E8 current algebra (elementary operators), composites not constructed.
summary_de: Eliminierung eines schweren Modus mit Kopplung lambda (b+b^dag) O_A gibt exakt -(lambda^2/Delta) sum O_A^2 (Fehler ~1/Delta). Theta1s Vertex ist genau ein schwerer reeller Spin(10)-Vektor (Spin-Singulett, Z4-ungerade); ein komplexer 10 gibt nur den U(1)-invarianten Teil, ein reeller (120,3) speist zwar Delta N = 4, bringt aber |P_120|^2 mit, 126 nur komplex. Die elementare Quelle hat als bosonische Spin(10)-Vektoren nur die masselosen (10,6)-Stroeme mit Familien-SO(6)-Index, ohne Familiensingulett: kein passender Mediator.
kills: An elementary heavy family-singlet real Spin(10)-vector mode in the current E8 source (only massless (10,6) family-vector currents).
Theta_1's ray from a complex 10, a real (120,3) or a 126 mediator alone.
resolved: Exact mediator dictionary: real 10 and real (120,3) feed Delta N = 4 (B nondegenerate), 126 cannot.
Required quantum numbers of the Gate-B interaction origin: heavy real Spin(10) vector, spin singlet, Z4-odd, on-site coupling to the filtered pair operator.
minimal_missing_inputs: heavy real (10,1) spin-singlet Z4-odd mode (composite or extended source) with coupling lambda and gap Delta, g = lambda^2/Delta
acceptance_chain: (10,1) bosonic spin-singlet Z4-odd source operator M_A
spectral pole <M_A(t)M_B(0)> ~ delta_AB Z_Phi exp(-Delta t), Z_Phi>0, 0<Delta<inf, Delta >> E_IR
Schrieffer-Wolff residual ||dH|| << lambda^2/Delta (no equally large unwanted operators)
caveat: The QMC Hubbard-Stratonovich field has the mediator quantum numbers but is a mathematical rewriting, not evidence of a physical mode.
